about:
Helena Agri Enterprises was founded in 1957 in West Helena, Arkansas. The company now operates from its headquarters in Collierville, Tennessee, with regional offices across the United States.

The company develops and manufactures crop inputs for agriculture, turf, and ornamental markets, and provides application technology, precision technology, data management, custom application, agronomic consultation, financial services, and digital tools. Its retail and wholesale distribution network spans more than 500 locations and employs over 6,000 people.

Helena serves the agriculture, turf, and ornamental industries, working with growers, retailers, and specialty markets to provide agronomic products and services.

Grounded by tradition yet empowered by innovation, Helena combines the power of relationships with forward-thinking ideas to meet evolving agronomic needs. The company emphasizes sustainability through its three pillars—People, Products, and Knowledge—aiming to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and support the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals.
